exposure: cesarean delivery (CD) at other stages of labor
cohort: 1574 women who underwent a cesarean delivery at first birth and returned for a second birth
finding: Mothers undergoing second-stage cesarean delivery experience a higher prevalence of low uterine incision extensions compared to other cesarean delivery types.
mod_finding: While there was no association between low-segment uterine incision extensions at first birth and preterm birth less than 37 weeks gestation at second birth, those with extensions at first birth were six times more likely to have a preterm delivery before 32 weeks gestation and twice as likely to have a preterm delivery between 32 and 34 weeks gestation.
